h1: Drinkware Quality Control and Sample Approval
lead: Use the approved product and artwork reference to define what quality control checks for the order. Keep the selected model, finish, components and packing identifiable through production.
html:
Define the acceptance criteria

Describe the defects, checks and inspection method in the project specification. Sampling results concern the inspected lot and plan; they do not guarantee zero defects in every item.

Keep the versions traceable

Record the approved sample and artwork version, then compare production and packing with that reference. Existing factory details remain as shown on the website; a marketing percentage is not a substitute for a defined inspection plan.
